<function=python>

# Let me move the green dot to (38, 12) - top-right corner

for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)

after = last_transition.after_frame

a_seg = after.segmentation['nodes']

        b_b = b_n['boundary']

        min_r_b = min(p[0] for p in b_b)
        min_c_b = min(p[1] for p in b_b)
        min_r_a = min(p[0] for p in a_b)
